summary: Recorded the repeat outcome in the main question's current account: the experiment that carries the main finding (acc6241dce584bc0a6817149dbe19f98-experiment) was executed again from its retained inputs in a clean copy and returned the same twelve comparison outcomes with the same witness indices — under-lease controls holding at 3, 4, 7 and 10; the peer-form MsgForgetLeader accepted at 5 and 13; the same pre-vote granted afterwards at 6 and 14; the vote granted at 15; the candidate leading at term 3 at 17; and the repair heartbeat plus the ignored pre-vote after it at 7 and 8 (receipt 3f8d0a1b83304e5c9032b909703bb1c4). That makes the account schedule-stable rather than the product of one favourable interleaving, so I folded it into the existing explanation instead of opening a new question, added the receipt to the executions, and added a limitation stating precisely what reproduction does and does not cover: the repeat applies to this experiment, while the later probes of this run were each executed once. Validation passed with no execution requested; the read-index follow-up (@readindex_leadership_loss) remains registered and unexecuted.
